name: stock_picking_restrict_cancel_with_orig_move
summary: Stops a transfer from being cancelled when it is part of a chain of moves whose earlier steps are still open. When someone tries, Odoo shows an error listing the earlier transfers so they can be dealt with first. It applies to operation types where the 'Restrict Cancellation with Original Moves' option is turned on.

name: stock_picking_restrict_partial_validation
summary: Lets you require that transfers of a chosen operation type are either fully reserved and moved in full, or not validated at all. This suits all-or-nothing transfers such as kit movements, where no backorder should ever be created. The option is switched on per operation type under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types, and users get a blocking message if they try to validate early or for less than the demand.

name: stock_picking_return_empty_package
summary: When goods come back from a customer in a package, this makes sure only the package contents go back into stock and the empty package itself does not. It is switched on with an 'Empty package at return' option on the return operation type. The effect shows up on the return transfer in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_return_lot
summary: When returning a lot or serial-tracked product, the return is split into one line per lot and pre-filled with the lots from the original delivery. That way the receiver knows exactly which lot numbers are accepted back. It is reached from the Return button on a done receipt or delivery in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_return_restricted_qty
summary: Stops a return from being larger than what was actually delivered. If a user tries to return more than was shipped, Odoo shows a warning. It is turned on per operation type with the 'Restrict Return Quantity' checkbox in Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: stock_picking_sale_order_link
summary: Adds a Sales Order smart button on transfers so you can jump from a delivery straight to the sale that created it. It is shown on the transfer form once a delivery has been generated from a confirmed sales order. It lives in Inventory on the transfer form and links back to Sales.

name: stock_picking_send_by_mail
summary: Lets you email a delivery order to someone directly from the transfer. A Send by Email button on the Delivery Order opens the standard mail composer with the picking attached. It is used from the Inventory transfer form.

name: stock_picking_show_backorder
summary: Shows on a transfer which backorders were created from it, in a new tab on the form. This is handy when a partial receipt or delivery has been validated and you want to see the remaining transfers at a glance. It appears on the transfer form in Inventory after you create a backorder.

name: stock_picking_show_lot
summary: Adds a button on transfers to open the lot or serial numbers created from that transfer, for operation types set to create new lots on the fly. It saves hunting through the lot list to find what was just entered. It appears on the transfer form in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_show_return
summary: Adds a Returns tab on a transfer that has returns, listing the return transfers that came from it. On a returned transfer it also adds an Origin picking button to jump back to the original transfer. Both appear on the transfer form in Inventory.

name: stock_picking_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to transfers. A user requests validation, the configured reviewers approve in tiers, and only then can the transfer be validated. Reviewers can filter for transfers that need their review, and the tiers are set up under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: stock_picking_to_batch_group_fields
summary: When grouping selected transfers into a new batch, you can choose one or more fields (such as customer, carrier or destination) to split them into separate batches. It makes it easier to prepare grouped shipments in one go. It is used from Inventory > Overview via Action > Add to batch, after batches are enabled in Settings.

name: stock_picking_type_bypass_reservation
summary: Lets an operation type reserve stock even when there is none on hand, so the transfer shows as fully reserved. This is mainly useful for testing or for flows where physical stock is handled outside Odoo. The option is set on an Internal or Outgoing operation type in Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types, with debug mode on.

name: stock_picking_type_force_move_type
summary: Forces the shipping policy on an operation type so it overrides the policy set on the sales procurement group. This is useful in pick, pack and ship setups where the pick step should wait until all goods are available. It is set on the operation type under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: stock_picking_variable_qty
summary: For multi-step deliveries, the quantity processed at the first step (such as Pick) can differ from what was ordered, and the later steps then follow that actual quantity. When the option is enabled on the upstream operation type, validating a step updates the downstream moves to match. It is set under Inventory > Configuration > Operation Types.

name: stock_picking_warn_message
summary: Shows a warning banner at the top of a transfer when the chosen customer or vendor has a warning set on their contact. Users need the Warnings option turned on in Inventory settings first. Warnings are then set on each partner record.

name: stock_picking_whole_scrap
summary: Lets you scrap all the quantities on a transfer in one step, including lots, owners and packages. A Scrap All button on a delivery opens a wizard prefilled with every line so you can review and confirm. It is used from Inventory > Dashboard > Delivery Orders.

name: stock_product_set
summary: Lets you add a predefined product set (a bundle of products) to a planned transfer in one click, with a line created for each product. It saves typing the same group of products over and over. It is used from the Add set button on a planned transfer in Inventory.

name: stock_production_lot_active
summary: Lets you archive lots and serial numbers that are no longer needed, and restore them later. Archived lots drop out of everyday lists so they stop cluttering selections. It appears on the lot and serial number records in Inventory.

name: stock_putaway_last_location
summary: When a product is put away, Odoo can suggest the location where that product was last put away, instead of the usual default. This keeps stock of the same product in the same place. It is turned on per location with the Putaway Default To Last Location option, which needs Storage Locations enabled in Inventory settings.

name: stock_receipt_lot_info
summary: When receiving lots or serial numbers, you can enter the best-before, removal and alert dates yourself instead of accepting the automatic calculations. These dates appear as optional columns in the detailed operations on a receipt. The lots then keep those dates, which is useful for expiry-tracked stock.

name: stock_reception_discrepancy_distribution
summary: When a receipt brings in more than was ordered and that stock was meant for several customer orders, a wizard lets you decide how to share the extra between those orders. This avoids creating an extra outgoing transfer. It appears on the receipt before it is validated, and needs the multi-step routes and Replenish on Order (MTO) route set up.

name: stock_reporting_access
summary: Adds an Inventory Reporting Access group so regular inventory users can open the Inventory Reporting menu without being full inventory administrators. Admins assign users to it in the group settings. It also notes that stock valuation layers need extra access rights when stock_account is installed.

name: stock_restrict_lot
summary: Adds a Restrict Lot field on stock moves and transfers so a line can be limited to one specific lot or serial number. The restriction passes along chained moves, so the same lot is used down the line. This is a base module with no visible effect on its own, and other modules build on it.

name: stock_scrap_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancelled status to scrap orders, so a scrap can be cancelled and then set back to draft if needed. Cancelling also removes its stock move. It appears on Inventory > Operations > Scrap with Cancel and Set to Draft buttons.

name: stock_scrap_security
summary: Sets up dedicated security groups for scrapping stock, so access to scrap orders can be limited to chosen users. The module text does not spell out which exact rights each group grants. It is configured through the access rights of the scrap model in Inventory.

name: stock_scrap_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval step to scrap orders. A user requests validation, the configured reviewers approve in tiers, and only then can the scrap be validated. Reviewers can filter for scraps that need their review, and tiers are set under Settings > Technical > Tier Validations.

name: stock_split_picking
summary: Adds a Split button on transfers that are ready, letting you break one transfer into two or more separate ones without validating it. Lines can be split by the quantities entered, or all moves can be put into their own transfers. Both resulting transfers stay confirmed and unprocessed. It is used from the transfer form in Inventory.

name: stock_split_picking_dimension
summary: Extends the split button so a transfer can be divided by size limits: maximum number of lines, volume and weight. Each new transfer stays within those limits, which helps when loading trucks or parcels. The By Dimension option is picked in the Split wizard on transfers in Inventory.

name: stock_split_picking_kit
summary: Adds a Quantity of kits mode to the Split wizard, so a transfer can be split into groups of a set number of kits. You can also choose the sort order used before splitting. Multi-level bills of materials are not supported. It is used from the Split button on transfers in Inventory.

name: stock_valuation_layer_usage
summary: Tracks which incoming stock valuation layers were used by each outgoing move, and how much quantity and value was taken from each. This makes it possible to trace costs when a purchase price changes later and a revaluation is needed. For make-to-order flows, the outgoing cost is taken from the specific incoming layer rather than simply the oldest, and usage appears under Inventory > Reporting > Stock Moves as a Valuation Layers section.

name: stock_warn_option
summary: Adds a choice of predefined warning options to a contact's 'Warning on the Picking' setting, so a blocking message can be set quickly rather than typed each time. It keeps the warning text consistent across partners. It is set on a partner's Internal Notes tab, with the Warnings setting enabled in Inventory.

name: crm_timesheet
summary: Lets you record timesheet time directly on CRM leads and opportunities, with a Timesheet tab on the lead form. It also links a lead to a project. It appears on the lead form in the CRM app.

name: hr_employee_cost_history
summary: Lets you change an employee's hourly timesheet cost from a chosen date onward, and keeps a log of every past change. A Cost History button on the employee shows how the rate has moved over time. It is used from the Employees app, via the Update Cost action on the employee's Settings tab.

name: hr_timesheet_amount_security
summary: Restricts the cost and amount figures on the timesheet reports so only users allowed to read analytic costs can see them. Users without that permission see the timesheet reports without the money columns. The restriction applies to the attendance and timesheet analysis reports.

name: hr_timesheet_autofill_project_off
summary: Turns off Odoo's automatic filling of the Project field on new timesheet lines. Users now choose the project each time instead of getting the one from their recent entries. No setup is needed, and it works as soon as the module is installed.

name: hr_timesheet_begin_end
summary: Adds Begin Hour and End Hour fields to each timesheet line, so you can record the start and finish times of work as well as the duration. These show on the timesheet entries in the Timesheets app. A similar feature exists in project_timesheet_time_control.

name: hr_timesheet_calendar
summary: Adds a calendar view to timesheets so time can be entered and seen against a calendar of days. Each entry gets a start time, and the alignment of timesheets in the calendar can be chosen in settings. It appears as a calendar view in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_date_order_desc
summary: Makes new timesheet lines appear at the top of the list and sorts the list by date, newest first. This makes it quicker to add and find recent entries. It applies to the timesheet list in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_day_week
summary: Adds a Day of Week field to timesheets, so you can search or group entries by weekday. Weekend entries are also shaded differently in the list views, with a filter to show only those. It appears in the Timesheets app and the timesheet analysis report.

name: hr_timesheet_editable_top
summary: Makes new timesheet lines appear at the top of the list instead of the bottom, so quick entries are easier to add. It is a small layout change to the timesheet list in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_employee_analytic_tag
summary: Lets you set analytic tags on each employee, and those tags are copied onto the timesheet entries and analytic items recorded for that employee. This keeps reporting consistent without choosing tags each time. The tags are set on the employee record and show up in Invoicing > Analytic Items.

name: hr_timesheet_name_customer
summary: Adds a separate Description Customer field to timesheet lines, used for customer-facing timesheets. It is copied from the internal description by default, and a Timesheet Customer report prints that version instead. The field is visible to Timesheets administrators in the timesheet list and form.

name: hr_timesheet_portal
summary: Lets portal users, such as external contractors or customers, add, edit and delete their own timesheet lines from the website. Users in the Editable timesheets group see plus and pencil buttons on their timesheets page. It is used on the website portal rather than the back office.

name: hr_timesheet_report
summary: Builds configurable timesheet reports from selected timesheet entries, or from a general date and employee filter. You choose the fields, grouping order and time format, then view the report in the browser or export it as PDF or Excel. It is opened from the Action menu in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet
summary: Adds timesheet sheets, which group each employee's time into a period (daily, weekly or monthly). Employees submit the sheet at the end of the period, and a reviewer approves it. The default period and reviewer are set in Timesheet Options under Settings.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_attendance
summary: Lets employees check in and out directly from their timesheet sheet, and compares the time they were present with the time they worked. Managers can see total attendance and the difference from the planned working time. It appears on the Attendances tab of the timesheet sheet.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_autodraft
summary: Automatically creates a draft timesheet sheet whenever a timesheet entry is added or changed and no suitable sheet covers it. This helps make sure every entry belongs to a sheet that can be submitted. It is switched on under Timesheets > Configuration > Settings in Timesheet Options.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_policy_department_manager
summary: Lets the Department Manager of an employee's department be the reviewer who approves timesheet sheets. You pick By Department Manager in the Timesheet Sheet Review Policy setting. Each department needs a manager set on it.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_policy_project_manager
summary: Lets the Project Manager of a project approve the timesheet sheets for that project. Sheets gain a Project field, and entries are filtered by it. You pick By Project Manager in the Timesheet Sheet Review Policy setting.

name: hr_timesheet_sheet_warning
summary: Lets managers define custom warning rules for timesheet sheets, using a Python expression such as a limit on hours. Odoo checks sheets against these rules and creates a warning on each sheet that matches. Rules are defined under Configuration > Warnings in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_task_domain
summary: Limits the Task field on timesheet lines so only tasks of the selected project appear, and only those in open stages. This stops people picking the wrong or closed task. It applies when entering time in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_task_required
summary: Makes the Task field compulsory on timesheets for projects that are set to require it. It can be turned on per project, with a company-wide default in Project settings. It applies when users enter timesheets in the Project and Timesheets apps.

name: hr_timesheet_task_stage
summary: Lets users open or close a task straight from a timesheet line. Closing moves the task to the first stage marked as Closed. It appears as a field on the timesheet entry in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_time_control_begin_end
summary: Adds Begin and End time fields to timesheet lines, built on the time control feature of project timesheets. It lets you record when work started and finished as well as how long it lasted. It appears on timesheet entries in the Timesheets app.

name: hr_timesheet_time_type
summary: Lets you tag each timesheet line with a Time Type to classify the kind of work it was. Time types are defined under Project > Configuration > Time Type. They help in planning and in client reports that group time by type.

name: hr_timesheet_type_non_billable
summary: Lets you mark a time type as non-billable, so timesheets logged with it do not reduce the remaining hours on a task or count as effective hours. This is useful for time that should be recorded but not charged against the project budget. It is set on the time type under Project > Configuration > Time Type.

name: hr_timesheet_unusual_days
summary: Shades weekends and public holidays in a different background color on the timesheet calendar, so they stand out when entering time. It works alongside the timesheet calendar view and time off holidays.

name: project_task_analytic_propagation
summary: Keeps analytic accounts in step when a task's account changes, so timesheets already recorded (even if validated or pending) pick up the new account. It also copies a project's analytic account to its tasks, and a task's project to its timesheets. It is used from sales orders, task smart buttons and the Extra Info tab.

name: project_timesheet_holidays_dynamic_description
summary: Copies the description from a time off request into the timesheet lines generated from it. This saves retyping the same note on the timesheet. It is switched on per leave type with the Dynamic Description option.

name: project_timesheet_holidays_editable
summary: Makes timesheet lines generated from time off editable again, instead of locked. This lets someone correct the hours actually worked, for example for medical leave. The edit level is set per time off type, with the Generate Timesheets option enabled.

name: sale_timesheet_budget
summary: Adds a Budget tab on projects, where you add expected income and expense lines against a planned budget. Lines can be positive or negative and are linked to the project's analytic account. The budget total shows on the project record in the Project app.

name: sale_timesheet_invoice_link
summary: Lets you link timesheet lines to an existing customer invoice of the same customer, so you can invoice work before the hours are actually done. The linked invoice shows as a column in the timesheet list. Users need the Timesheets Administrator permission.

name: sale_timesheet_line_exclude
summary: Lets you exclude a specific timesheet entry from being invoiced on the sales order, even when its task is billed. This is useful for billing by task when one entry should not be charged. You tick Non-billable on the timesheet list or on the task's Timesheets tab.

name: sale_timesheet_rounded
summary: Rounds timesheet amounts to a set unit on each project, so 5 minutes of work can be invoiced as 15 minutes. The rounding unit and method are set on the project, and each entry can still be overridden by hand. The rounded quantity flows into the sales order and invoice.

name: sale_timesheet_timeline
summary: Lets you plan start and end dates and assignees for service lines on a sales order, using a timeline view. Those dates and people carry over to the task created when the order is confirmed. The plan is also shown to customers on the order portal.

name: web_action_conditionable
summary: Adds conditions to the Create and Delete actions on one2many list fields. This lets a developer decide when a user may add or remove lines inside a form. It has no screen of its own and is meant for developers building forms.

name: web_calendar_slot_duration
summary: Lets developers set custom time slot lengths in backend calendar views, for example 30 minutes or 10 minutes, so events snap to the chosen grid. It has no end-user feature by itself and needs another module that uses it. Demo data changes the Scheduled Actions calendar to 10-minute slots.

name: web_chatter_position
summary: Lets each user choose where the chatter (messages and activity panel) sits on a form: auto, bottom or to the side. The choice is made in User Preferences, and the form can use the full width. It works in both Community and Enterprise.

name: web_company_color
summary: Changes the colors of the top navigation bar and buttons to match the company logo. Colors are set in the Navbar section of the company form, and a logo with transparency gives the best result. The change is seen throughout the backend.

name: web_copy_confirm
summary: Shows a confirmation pop-up when a user picks Duplicate from the Action menu on a form, so a record is not copied by accident. The user confirms before the copy is made. It applies to standard form views in any app.

name: web_dark_mode
summary: Adds a dark mode to the Odoo backend for Community users. Each user switches it on from the user menu at the top right, and can choose to follow their device setting. It changes only the look of the backend.

name: web_datetime_picker_default_time
summary: Lets a date-and-time field take a default time when the user only picks a date, such as 17:00 for a commitment date. Without it, the time used is the time the page was opened. The default is set in the form view, either as a fixed value or computed from a field.

name: web_dialog_size
summary: Adds a button to every dialog window to expand it to full width and restore it again, and lets dialogs be dragged around. Administrators can set dialogs to open maximized by default with a system parameter. The button sits in the top right corner of pop-up dialogs.

name: web_disable_export_group
summary: Adds a separate Direct Export (xlsx) group, so a user can be allowed the quick export from a list view without getting the full Export All feature. Admins always keep full export rights. It is set by assigning users to the group in the user settings.

name: web_editor_class_selector
summary: Lets administrators define custom CSS class names that users can apply to blocks in the HTML editor, such as signatures or templates. The actual CSS must be loaded by a custom module. Classes are set up under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Web editor Class.

name: web_editor_disable_chatgpt
summary: Removes the ChatGPT option from the HTML editor, so users cannot generate or rewrite text with it. It takes effect on installation and has no other visible change. Use it where AI text tools are not wanted.

name: web_environment_ribbon
summary: Shows a red ribbon with a TEST label in the top left corner of every backend page, so test or staging databases are easy to tell apart from live ones. The label and colors can be changed or hidden with system parameters. It appears on all backend screens once installed.

name: web_excel_export_dynamic_expand
summary: When exporting a grouped list to Excel, it exports either only the main groups or the full tree, depending on whether the groups are collapsed or one is open. This means the export matches what is on screen. It applies to grouped list views.

name: web_favicon
summary: Lets you set a custom browser tab icon (favicon) on the company record, for branding or to tell several Odoo instances apart. The icon also shows for portal users when the website apps are not installed. Browsers cache icons, so a change may need a cache clear to appear.

name: web_filter_header_button
summary: Lets selected search filters appear as buttons in the top control panel of a list or kanban view, rather than only inside the filter dropdown. Users click a button to apply the filter straight away. Developers choose which filters to show with a context setting.

name: web_font_size_report_layout
summary: Adds a Font Size setting to the Document Layout wizard, so company PDF reports such as invoices, quotations and sales orders can be printed in a chosen size from 9 pt to 14 pt. The standard size is 10 pt. It is set under Settings > General Settings > Companies > Configure Document Layout.

name: web_form_banner
summary: Shows configurable alert banners at the top of backend forms, such as a warning on a sale order that needs attention. Rules pick the model and views, the message, the severity and when to show it. Rules are set up under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Form Banner Rules.

name: web_group_expand
summary: Adds Expand all and Collapse all buttons to grouped list views, so every group opens or closes in one click. The buttons sit in the top right, where the pager normally is. It works one group level at a time.

name: web_help
summary: Adds an interactive help framework that walks users through a screen step by step, with help bubbles they can reopen at any time. It is open to all users, not just admins, and does not force them to create records. A demo guide is reached from the question mark button next to the view switcher on the Users list.

name: web_ir_actions_act_multi
summary: Lets a button trigger several actions at once, such as closing a dialog and then reloading the page. This is a developer feature with no screen of its own. It is used by code that returns a list of actions.

name: web_ir_actions_act_window_message
summary: Lets a button show a pop-up message box with a title and text to the user, such as a confirmation or a result. The close button text can be changed or hidden. This is a developer feature used by server code, with no screen of its own.

name: web_loading_block_ui
summary: When a request takes longer than a set delay, such as opening a heavy report or saving a large record, the whole screen is blurred with a centered Loading spinner until it finishes. This brings back the behavior of Odoo 16 and earlier. The delay is set by a system parameter in milliseconds, with 3000 as the default.

name: web_m2x_options
summary: Adds options to Many2one and Many2many dropdowns in form fields. You can hide the Create and Create and Edit entries, change how many suggestions appear, and show colors on tags. Create options are hidden automatically if the user cannot create the record anyway.

name: web_m2x_options_manager
summary: Gives a screen under Settings > Technical > Models to choose the Create and Create and Edit options for relational fields, without editing code. Each model's form has a Create/Edit Options tab listing its fields. It is for administrators who want to control those dropdown entries.

name: web_no_bubble
summary: Removes the guided bubbles that Odoo shows on screens. Help boxes are kept. It is for users who find the bubbles distracting, and it takes effect once installed.

name: web_notify
summary: Lets the server send live pop-up notifications to a user's screen, in success, warning, danger, info or default colors. This is a technical module: developers call it from code, and users see the message appear on screen. Each user can have their own channel names for these notices.

name: web_notify_channel_message
summary: Sends an instant notification to everyone in a Discuss channel when a new message is posted there. Members see it on screen straight away without having to check the channel. It is for channel members in the Discuss app.

name: web_notify_upgrade
summary: Sends a notice to all active users when a module is installed or upgraded, asking them to refresh the page to see the changes. It helps avoid users working on a stale screen after an update. It is a technical module that runs in the background.

name: web_pivot_computed_measure
summary: Adds a Computed Measure option to the pivot view's Measures menu. You can combine two measures with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division or percentage, and the result shows as a new column. It works on pivot reports in any app.

name: web_portal_properties
summary: Adds a Show in portal setting to custom properties, so chosen property values appear on the customer portal for that record. Users can also edit them there when the field uses the portal widget. Developers add the setting to the field definition.

name: web_pwa_customize
summary: Lets you set the name, icon and colors used when Odoo is installed as a Progressive Web App on a phone or computer. These are set under Settings > General Settings in the Progressive Web App section. It affects how the app looks once installed.

name: web_quick_start_screen
summary: Gives users a configurable start screen of quick action buttons when they log in, so they go straight to common tasks. It can be set per user or used as shared screens. Quick actions are created under Settings > Technical > User Interface > Screen actions.

name: web_refresher
summary: Adds a refresh button next to the pager on list and kanban views, so the displayed records reload without a full page refresh. It is a small convenience button available on any list or kanban screen.

name: web_remember_tree_column_width
summary: Remembers the width each user sets for list view columns, so the layout is kept across sessions and after filtering, grouping or reordering. Users do not have to resize columns again each time they open a list. It applies to all list views.

name: web_responsive
summary: Makes the backend work better on phones and tablets and adds several desktop shortcuts. Highlights include a full-screen app menu with search, sticky list headers, bigger checkboxes, and Alt+Shift+number keyboard shortcuts. It also lets users choose whether to be redirected to the home page after login.

name: web_responsive_company_color
summary: Connects the responsive layout to the company color settings, so the elements added by web_responsive use the same colors set for the company. It has no screen of its own, and it should be installed alongside both modules. Colors are set as described in the company color module.

name: web_save_discard_button
summary: Restyles the Save and Discard buttons on forms so they are easier to see. It is a visual change only and applies across backend forms. It has no settings.

name: web_search_with_and
summary: Lets a user search the same field twice and get records matching both terms, instead of either term. For example, searching for customers named John and then Smith returns contacts containing both. Hold Shift while choosing the field in the search bar to switch to AND.

name: web_send_message_popup
summary: Changes the Send a message link under a record's chatter so it opens the full email pop-up straight away, with subject, templates, attachments and followers. This skips the small text box step. It applies to the chatter on every form.

name: web_session_auto_close
summary: Logs out users who have been inactive for a set time, and returns the page to the login screen. The timeout, in seconds, is set in Settings > General. It helps protect shared computers and sensitive data.

name: web_sort_menu
summary: Sorts the app names in the apps dropdown and the top navigation menu alphabetically, based on the user's language. The sorting applies automatically after installation, with no settings.

name: web_systray_button_init_action
summary: Adds a button to the top bar that jumps to the user's chosen home action, such as their preferred screen. It appears only when a home action is set in the user's preferences. Debug mode is needed to set that preference.

name: web_theme_classic
summary: Makes input fields easier to see by giving them a visible border and marking required fields clearly, similar to the Odoo 15 look. Each user can switch it on for themselves, or make it persistent across devices in preferences. It changes only the look of the backend.

name: web_time_range_menu_custom
summary: Adds a Custom Period option to the date filter menu, so users can build their own date ranges such as the last 7 days. The same option is available for the comparison period in pivot views. It applies to any screen with date-based filters.

name: web_timeline
summary: Adds a Timeline view that shows records as bars or events on a zoomable time axis, for example for planning or scheduling. Users switch to it with the clock icon in the view switcher. Developers set it up with a view definition naming the start and end date fields.

name: web_toggle_chatter
summary: Adds a button on backend forms to show or hide the chatter, the messages and activity panel. This frees room for the form when the chatter is not needed. It appears on any form view once installed.

name: web_touchscreen
summary: On tablets and other touchscreen devices, sub-forms in one2many fields use the kanban-style view, which is easier to tap. It applies on any device with a touch screen, whatever its size. It is used on forms that contain such sub-views, such as a sale order's lines.

name: web_tree_column_keyboard_resize
summary: Lets users widen or narrow a list column with Shift plus the Up or Down arrow while editing a row, without using the mouse. The change lasts only while that row is being edited, and then the column returns to its normal width. It applies in editable list views.

name: web_tree_dynamic_colored_field
summary: Lets developers color a list cell's background or text based on the record's data, for example red for customers. It is set up in the list view definition with options on the field. It is a technical module with no screen of its own.

name: web_tree_many2one_clickable
summary: Makes many2one and reference fields in list views clickable, so you can open the linked record with a button without going into the form. Hover over a cell and click the button that appears. It is turned on automatically after installation.

name: web_widget_bokeh_chart
summary: Lets developers display interactive Bokeh charts inside standard Odoo views, using a computed field that holds the chart. It is for developers building custom chart screens. It has no end-user feature of its own.

name: web_widget_char_size
summary: Adds a size option to Char fields so the input accepts only a set number of characters. The option is set in the view definition. The older way of setting size on the field itself is deprecated.

name: web_widget_domain_editor_dialog
summary: Lets users edit a domain filter in a pop-up dialog and see the matching records as they build it. It is most useful in user-defined filters, where a user picks a model and adds conditions. In debug mode it is reached from Settings > Technical > User Interface > User-defined Filters.

name: web_widget_dropdown_dynamic
summary: Lets a Char, Integer or Selection field fill its dropdown choices from server code, so the options can change depending on other values. The choices can be narrowed based on context, such as what a user has already filled in. It is for developers, and the demo is on the user-defined filters screen.

name: web_widget_image_download
summary: Adds a Download button to image fields, so a user can save the picture to their computer. In the example, it appears on a contact's form in the Contacts app. It is an extra action on image widgets.

name: web_widget_mpld3_chart
summary: Lets developers show interactive matplotlib charts inside standard Odoo views, using a JSON field that holds the chart. It is for developers building custom chart screens. It has no end-user feature of its own.

name: web_widget_numeric_step
summary: Adds plus and minus buttons beside number fields, so values can be nudged up or down in edit mode. The step size and minimum and maximum limits can be set in the view. The Credit Limit field on a user record is the demo.

name: web_widget_o2m_attachment_image_gallery
summary: Lets a view show a set of images as a gallery, such as a kanban of product or record pictures. It is set up in the view XML. It is for developers building image-heavy screens.

name: web_widget_one2many_tree_line_duplicate
summary: Adds a clone icon to each line of a one2many list, so a line can be copied in one click. The copy does not run the normal default or onchange values. It is turned on per field with an allow_clone option in the view.

name: web_widget_open_tab
summary: Adds a button in a list that opens the record in a new browser tab, while a normal click still opens it in the same window. This is useful when a user wants to keep a list open and check a record elsewhere. It is set on a field in the list view, or added as an option on the model in Technical settings.

name: web_widget_pattern
summary: Lets a text field be checked against a pattern, such as digits only, when a user types in it. The pattern can be set in the Python field definition or on the view. Demo data limits the second address line on partner forms to numbers.

name: web_widget_popover
summary: Shows a Char or Text field as a small icon, and the full text appears in a tooltip when the user hovers over it. This keeps long notes out of the way on busy forms. It is set on the field in the view with the popover widget.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_full_label
summary: Shows the full text of an invoice or purchase order line in the product label widget, including the product name. Previously the widget hid the product name from the label, which made editing descriptions confusing. It applies to lines on invoices and purchase orders.

name: web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_name_visibility
summary: Adds an eye icon on invoice lines that toggles whether the product name shows in the line description. Users can hide the product name and keep only the description. It appears on the customer invoice lines in Invoicing > Customers > Invoices.

name: web_widget_url_advanced
summary: Lets a URL field show a custom link text, such as the partner's name, instead of the raw web address. You can also add a prefix to the link. Many2one fields work too, using their display name. It is set in the view definition.

name: web_widget_x2many_2d_matrix
summary: Shows a one-to-many list as a grid, with one axis for rows, one for columns and editable cells where they meet. For example, a manager can enter planned hours for each employee against each task in one table. It is a technical widget that other modules use.
